# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and cache corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 will improve filtered-image and glyph rendering without changing public APIs. The upcoming update prevents sampling outside intended image subsets and corrects image-filter cache-key comparisons.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep filtered images within texture subsets** — Corrects subset sampling under minification, strong skew, antialiasing clips, and multisampling. Logical texture bounds and strict sampling constraints for transparent borders prevent unrelated backing-store pixels from leaking into filtered images. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Consistent image-filter caching** — Aligns image-filter cache-key equality with its bytewise hash, accounting for signed-zero representations, matrix type metadata, and subnormal values so lookup and LRU eviction use consistent key identity. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Correct mask-filtered glyph handling** — Uses the reloaded glyph's own outline when font-scaler loads disagree. Clears incompatible masks before overlap copies and preserves full plane strides for clipped emboss masks, avoiding stale outlines, format assertions, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and uncleared mask planes. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
